tokenization_note: Conversation reconstructed from trajectory and raw server replies. vLLM reasoning was mapped into assistant text with an explicit <|think|> marker and the tool-call argument was represented as plain text; native structured tool-call/channel serialization is not reproduced token-for-token. Only final 512 rendered prompt tokens retained, removing earlier context. Native prompt token count is a comparison target, not expected to match diagnostic suffix length. Chosen 64 positions teacher-force the saved command argument from anomaly onset, not the native full completion.

native_prompt_token_count_mismatch.explanation: The reconstruction count differs because original tool-call/channel messages were represented as plain text; the diagnostic then intentionally keeps only the last 512 tokens.

completion_count_note.explanation: Native count covers reasoning plus structured tool-call generation; the 64 chosen tokens cover only the saved tool argument starting at the typo. Raw token IDs were not logged.
